newsitem.title: UK: LME copper off high, others flat to slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: LME copper off high, others flat to slightly lower.

text.p: COPPER - Held below $2,200 in quiet trade despite firming cash/threes backwardation. First support $2,185.
ALUMINIUM - Gives up early gains as copper rally fades and stocks show another increase. Chart support pegged at $1,550.
NICKEL - Slightly lower. ZINC - Flat. LEAD - A shade weaker.
TIN - Unchanged from Thursday. ALLOY - Slightly firmer.
